+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),
+                  ("no-records", {"T2_MUTANT": "no-records"})):
+    print(name, [(h, run(h, env)[:2]) for h in harnesses])
+
+for mutant in ("no-records", "raise-record"):
+    for h in harnesses:
+        print("emit-launder", mutant, h, run(h, {"T2_MUTANT": mutant}, ("--emit-expected",)))
+
+for h in harnesses:
+    print("unknown-arg", h, run(h, {}, ("--definitely-a-typo",))[:2])

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),
+                  ("no-records", {"T2_MUTANT": "no-records"})):

+    for h in harnesses:
+        print("emit-launder", mutant, h, run(h, {"T2_MUTANT": mutant}, ("--emit-expected",)))
+
+for h in harnesses:
+    print("unknown-arg", h, run(h, {}, ("--definitely-a-typo",))[:2])

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),
+                  ("no-records", {"T2_MUTANT": "no-records"})):
+    print(name, [(h, run(h, env)[:2]) for h in harnesses])
+
+for mutant in ("no-records", "raise-record"):
+    for h in harnesses:
+        print("emit-launder", mutant, h, run(h, {"T2_MUTANT": mutant}, ("--emit-expected",)))
+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],

+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),
+                  ("no-records", {"T2_MUTANT": "no-records"})):
+    print(name, [(h, run(h, env)[:2]) for h in harnesses])

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),
+                  ("no-records", {"T2_MUTANT": "no-records"})):
+    print(name, [(h, run(h, env)[:2]) for h in harnesses])
+
+for mutant in ("no-records", "raise-record"):
+    for h in harnesses:
+        print("emit-launder", mutant, h, run(h, {"T2_MUTANT": mutant}, ("--emit-expected",)))
+
