+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+lineno=re.compile(r":\d+")
+diff=[]
+for script,auto,fixture_name in ir.CASES:
+    proc,rows,fx=ir.run_one(script,auto,fixture_name,True)
+    parsed=[]
+    raw_pairs=[]
+    for raw in (proc.stdout+"\n"+proc.stderr).splitlines():
+        m=ir.FINDING_RE.match(raw)
+        if m:
+            line=m.group(1).replace(str(fx)+"/","").replace(str(fx),"")
+            normalized=lineno.sub(":N",line)
+            parsed.append(normalized)
+            raw_pairs.append((normalized,m.group(1)))
+    if len(parsed)!=len(set(parsed)):
+        duplicates={n:[raw for norm,raw in raw_pairs if norm==n] for n in set(parsed) if parsed.count(n)>1}
+        diff.append((script,len(parsed),len(set(parsed)),len(parsed)-len(set(parsed)),duplicates))
+print("raw-parsed vs registry-normalized-set",diff)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import importlib.util,re
+from pathlib import Path
+spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ir","/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/independent_repro.py")
+ir=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(ir)
+lineno=re.compile(r":\d+")
+diff=[]
+for script,auto,fixture_name in ir.CASES:
+    proc,rows,fx=ir.run_one(script,auto,fixture_name,True)
+    parsed=[]
+    raw_pairs=[]
+    for raw in (proc.stdout+"\n"+proc.stderr).splitlines():
+        m=ir.FINDING_RE.match(raw)
+        if m:
+            line=m.group(1).replace(str(fx)+"/","").replace(str(fx),"")
+            normalized=lineno.sub(":N",line)
+            parsed.append(normalized)
+            raw_pairs.append((normalized,m.group(1)))
+    if len(parsed)!=len(set(parsed)):
+        duplicates={n:[raw for norm,raw in raw_pairs if norm==n] for n in set(parsed) if parsed.count(n)>1}
+        diff.append((script,len(parsed),len(set(parsed)),len(parsed)-len(set(parsed)),duplicates))
+print("raw-parsed vs registry-normalized-set",diff)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),
+                  ("no-records", {"T2_MUTANT": "no-records"})):
+    print(name, [(h, run(h, env)[:2]) for h in harnesses])
+
+for mutant in ("no-records", "raise-record"):
+    for h in harnesses:
+        print("emit-launder", mutant, h, run(h, {"T2_MUTANT": mutant}, ("--emit-expected",)))
+
+for h in harnesses:
+    print("unknown-arg", h, run(h, {}, ("--definitely-a-typo",))[:2])

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+lineno=re.compile(r":\d+")
+diff=[]
+for script,auto,fixture_name in ir.CASES:
+    proc,rows,fx=ir.run_one(script,auto,fixture_name,True)
+    parsed=[]
+    raw_pairs=[]
+    for raw in (proc.stdout+"\n"+proc.stderr).splitlines():
+        m=ir.FINDING_RE.match(raw)
+        if m:
+            line=m.group(1).replace(str(fx)+"/","").replace(str(fx),"")
+            normalized=lineno.sub(":N",line)
+            parsed.append(normalized)
+            raw_pairs.append((normalized,m.group(1)))
+    if len(parsed)!=len(set(parsed)):
+        duplicates={n:[raw for norm,raw in raw_pairs if norm==n] for n in set(parsed) if parsed.count(n)>1}
+        diff.append((script,len(parsed),len(set(parsed)),len(parsed)-len(set(parsed)),duplicates))
+print("raw-parsed vs registry-normalized-set",diff)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),
+                  ("no-records", {"T2_MUTANT": "no-records"})):
+    print(name, [(h, run(h, env)[:2]) for h in harnesses])
+
+for mutant in ("no-records", "raise-record"):
+    for h in harnesses:
+        print("emit-launder", mutant, h, run(h, {"T2_MUTANT": mutant}, ("--emit-expected",)))
+
+for h in harnesses:
+    print("unknown-arg", h, run(h, {}, ("--definitely-a-typo",))[:2])

   122	def _synthesis_raises(mod: ast.AST) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
   123	    """`from` 없이 인프라 DB 예외를 *생성*(Call)해 raise 하는 지점 — (lineno, exc_name)."""
   124	    out: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
   125	    for node in ast.walk(mod):
   126	        if not isinstance(node, ast.Raise):
   127	            continue
   128	        if node.cause is not None:          # `raise ... from X` → 원본 보존(면제).
   129	            continue
   130	        exc = node.exc
   131	        if not isinstance(exc, ast.Call):   # 변수 재던지기·bare 클래스 → 정당 전파(면제).
   132	            continue
   133	        nm = _call_name(exc.func)
   134	        if nm in TARGET_EXC:
   135	            out.append((node.lineno, nm))
   136	    return out

   139	def _is_catch_all(handler: ast.ExceptHandler) -> bool:
   140	    t = handler.type
   141	    if t is None:
   142	        return True  # bare `except:`
   143	    if isinstance(t, ast.Tuple):
   144	        return any(_call_name(el) in CATCH_ALL for el in t.elts)
   145	    return _call_name(t) in CATCH_ALL

   410	def _load_source(root: Path, relative: Path) -> ParsedSource:
   411	    lexical = root / relative
   412	    try:
   413	        resolved = lexical.resolve()
   414	        resolved.relative_to(root)
   415	    except ValueError as exc:
   416	        raise UsageError(f"production source root/symlink 탈출: {relative}") from exc
   417	    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as exc:
   418	        raise UsageError(f"production source resolve 불능: {relative} ({exc})") from exc
   419	    try:
   420	        if not resolved.is_file():
   421	            raise UsageError(f"production source 없음: {relative}")
   422	        source = resolved.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
   423	        compile(source, relative.as_posix(), "exec", dont_inherit=True)
   424	        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=relative.as_posix())
   425	    except UsageError:
   426	        raise
   427	    except (OSError, UnicodeError, SyntaxError) as exc:
   428	        raise UsageError(f"production source 분석 불능: {relative} ({exc})") from exc
   429	    return ParsedSource(relative, source, tree)

   432	def _selected_sources(config: Config, inventory: Inventory) -> list[ParsedSource]:
   433	    inventory_paths = set(inventory.paths)
   434	    issues: list[str] = []

   452	def _positional_sources(config: Config, inventory: Inventory) -> list[ParsedSource]:
   453	    candidate_paths = (
   454	        set(inventory.paths)
   455	        if inventory.git_root is None
   456	        else set(inventory.paths) & set(inventory.changed)
   457	    )
   458	    parsed: list[ParsedSource] = []

    92	def _snake(name: str) -> str:
    93	    """CamelCase → snake_case. 연속 대문자(약어)는 한 마디로(`HTTPLog` → `http_log`)."""
    94	    s = re.sub(r"([A-Z]+)([A-Z][a-z])", r"\1_\2", name)
    95	    s = re.sub(r"([a-z\d])([A-Z])", r"\1_\2", s)
    96	    return s.lower()

    99	def _new_paths(root: Path) -> set[Path] | None:
   100	    """git 신규(untracked `??`·staged `A`) 파일 절대경로 집합. None = git 저장소가 아니다."""
   101	    if not (root / ".git").exists():
   102	        return None
   103	    try:
   104	        res = subprocess.run(
   105	            ["git", "-C", str(root), "status", "--porcelain", "-uall"],
   106	            capture_output=True, text=True,
   107	        )
   108	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
   109	        return None
   110	    if res.returncode != 0:
   111	        return None
   112	    out: set[Path] = set()
   113	    for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
   114	        code, rest = line[:2], line[3:]
   115	        if "?" not in code and "A" not in code:
   116	            continue
   117	        path = rest.strip().strip('"')
   118	        if " -> " in path:
   119	            path = path.split(" -> ")[-1]
   120	        out.add((root / path).resolve())
   121	    return out

+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+ir=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(ir)
+lineno=re.compile(r":\d+")
+diff=[]
+for script,auto,fixture_name in ir.CASES:
+    proc,rows,fx=ir.run_one(script,auto,fixture_name,True)
+    parsed=[]
+    raw_pairs=[]
+    for raw in (proc.stdout+"\n"+proc.stderr).splitlines():
+        m=ir.FINDING_RE.match(raw)
+        if m:
+            line=m.group(1).replace(str(fx)+"/","").replace(str(fx),"")
+            normalized=lineno.sub(":N",line)
+            parsed.append(normalized)
+            raw_pairs.append((normalized,m.group(1)))
+    if len(parsed)!=len(set(parsed)):
+        duplicates={n:[raw for norm,raw in raw_pairs if norm==n] for n in set(parsed) if parsed.count(n)>1}
+        diff.append((script,len(parsed),len(set(parsed)),len(parsed)-len(set(parsed)),duplicates))
+print("raw-parsed vs registry-normalized-set",diff)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json

+import subprocess

+

+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),

+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),

+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+diff=[]
+for script,auto,fixture_name in ir.CASES:
+    proc,rows,fx=ir.run_one(script,auto,fixture_name,True)
+    parsed=[]
+    raw_pairs=[]

+        m=ir.FINDING_RE.match(raw)
+        if m:
+            line=m.group(1).replace(str(fx)+"/","").replace(str(fx),"")
+            normalized=lineno.sub(":N",line)
+            parsed.append(normalized)
+            raw_pairs.append((normalized,m.group(1)))
+    if len(parsed)!=len(set(parsed)):
+        duplicates={n:[raw for norm,raw in raw_pairs if norm==n] for n in set(parsed) if parsed.count(n)>1}
+        diff.append((script,len(parsed),len(set(parsed)),len(parsed)-len(set(parsed)),duplicates))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),
+                  ("no-records", {"T2_MUTANT": "no-records"})):
+    print(name, [(h, run(h, env)[:2]) for h in harnesses])
+
+for mutant in ("no-records", "raise-record"):
+    for h in harnesses:
+        print("emit-launder", mutant, h, run(h, {"T2_MUTANT": mutant}, ("--emit-expected",)))
+
+for h in harnesses:
+    print("unknown-arg", h, run(h, {}, ("--definitely-a-typo",))[:2])

+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path("/tmp/t2-lane-s.10aj4W/repo")
+harnesses = ("checker_baseline_matrix.py", "findings_count_matrix.py")
+
+def run(harness, extra_env=None, args=()):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+
+for name, env in (("extra-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_EXTRA": "1"}),
+                  ("missing-EXPECTED", {"T2_EXPECTED_DROP": "1"}),
+                  ("no-records", {"T2_MUTANT": "no-records"})):
+    print(name, [(h, run(h, env)[:2]) for h in harnesses])
+
+for mutant in ("no-records", "raise-record"):
+    for h in harnesses:
+        print("emit-launder", mutant, h, run(h, {"T2_MUTANT": mutant}, ("--emit-expected",)))
+
+for h in harnesses:
+    print("unknown-arg", h, run(h, {}, ("--definitely-a-typo",))[:2])

+            line=m.group(1).replace(str(fx)+"/","").replace(str(fx),"")
+            found.add(lineno.sub(":N",line))
+    gate_entries=len(found) if found else (1 if proc.returncode else 0)
+    violations=sum(r["severity"]=="violation" for r in rows)
+    if gate_entries != violations:
+        diff.append((script,violations,gate_entries,violations-gate_entries))
+print("checker, violation_records, registry_gate_entries, lost_or_collapsed")
+for row in diff: print(row)
+print("mismatching",len(diff),"of",len(ir.CASES),"total violations",sum(x[1] for x in diff),"gate entries",sum(x[2] for x in diff))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Independent T2-1 measurement: no project harness/module imports."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/hyun/Desktop/dddjango").resolve()
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "dddjango" / "scripts"
+FIXTURES = ROOT / "workspace" / "eval" / "fixtures"
+
+# Deliberately duplicated from the public checker/fixture contract.  This script
+# never imports checker_registry, fixture_matrix, either new harness, or registry_gate.
+CASES = (
+    ("check-mechanism-ownership.py", False, "mechanism_ownership"),
+    ("check-error-centralization.py", True, "error_centralization"),
+    ("check-response-schema-bypass.py", False, "response_schema_bypass"),
+    ("check-layer-skeleton.py", False, "skeleton"),
+    ("check-openapi-error-declaration.py", True, "openapi_error_declaration"),
+    ("check-context-isolation.py", False, "context_isolation"),
+    ("check-app-container.py", False, "app_container"),
+    ("check-ninja-boundary-middleware.py", False, "ninja_boundary_middleware"),
+    ("check-common-container.py", False, "common_container"),
+    ("check-idempotency-scope-creep.py", False, "idempotency_scope_creep"),
+    ("check-public-surface-annotation.py", False, "public_surface"),
+    ("check-test-config.py", False, "test_config"),
+    ("check-transient-overmapping.py", False, "transient_overmapping"),
+    ("check-synthetic-infra-exc.py", False, "synthetic_infra_exc"),
+    ("check-api-error-controller-contract.py", True, "api_error_controller"),
+    ("check-composition-root.py", False, "composition_root"),
+    ("check-db-table.py", False, "db_table"),
+    ("check-choices-literal-consumption.py", False, "choices_literal"),
+    ("check-usecase-dto-placement.py", False, "usecase_dto"),
+    ("check-transaction-boundary.py", False, "transaction_boundary"),
+    ("check-domain-model.py", False, "domain_model"),
+    ("check-port-adapter-pairing.py", False, "port_adapter_pairing"),
+    ("check-event-publish.py", False, "event_publish"),
+    ("check-broker-contract.py", False, "broker_contract"),
+    ("check-missable-entrance.py", False, "missable_entrance"),
+    ("check-naming.py", False, "naming"),
+    ("check-business-vocabulary.py", False, "business_vocabulary"),
+)
+
+FINDING_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\[#\d+\].*)$")
+CROSS_RE = re.compile(r"\[ⓓ?#(\d+)\]")
+
+
+def expected_from_source(path: Path) -> dict:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            target = node.targets[0] if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else node.target
+            if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "EXPECTED":
+                return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"EXPECTED not found: {path}")
+
+
+def argv(script: str, target: Path, auto: bool) -> list[str]:
+    out = [sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / script), str(target)]
+    if auto:
+        out += ["--error-profile", "auto"]
+    return out
+
+
+def lane(fixture: str, red: bool) -> Path:
+    if fixture == "skeleton":
+        return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_legacy_flat" if red else "good_bc")
+    return FIXTURES / fixture / ("bad_rules" if red else "good")
+
+
+def load_records(path: Path, fixture: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return []
+    rows = []
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        row = json.loads(line)
+        row["file"] = str(row["file"]).replace(str(fixture), "<FX>")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def summary(code: int, rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str, str]:
+    vio = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"]
+    info = [r for r in rows if r["severity"] == "info"]
+    dist = Counter(
+        r["rule"] or (f"sentinel:{r['sentinel']}" if r["sentinel"] else f"contract:{r['contract_ref']}")
+        for r in rows
+    )
+    dist_s = ",".join(f"{key}×{dist[key]}" for key in sorted(dist))
+    identities = sorted(
+        (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+        for r in vio
+    )
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identities, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return code, len(vio), len(info), dist_s, digest
+
+
+def run_one(script: str, auto: bool, fixture_name: str, red: bool) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[dict], Path]:
+    td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+    # Keep TemporaryDirectory alive by attaching it to the CompletedProcess.
+    fixture = Path(td.name) / "fixture"
+    shutil.copytree(lane(fixture_name, red), fixture)
+    record_path = Path(td.name) / "records.jsonl"
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["DJR_FINDINGS_JSON"] = str(record_path)
+    proc = subprocess.run(argv(script, fixture, auto), cwd=ROOT, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    rows = load_records(record_path, fixture)
+    proc._t2_tempdir = td  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return proc, rows, fixture
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    baseline_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/checker_baseline_matrix.py")
+    count_expected = expected_from_source(ROOT / "workspace/tools/findings_count_matrix.py")
+    baseline_mismatch = []
+    count_mismatch = []
+    schema_bad = []
+    green_bad = []
+    blank_observations = []
+    cross_only = []
+    duplicate_ids = []
+    total_records = 0
+    for script, auto, fixture_name in CASES:
+        proc, rows, fixture = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, True)
+        merged = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
+        all_lines = merged.splitlines()
+        nonblank = [line for line in all_lines if line.strip()]
+        parsed = sum(bool(FINDING_RE.match(line)) for line in nonblank)
+        unparsed = sum(not FINDING_RE.match(line) for line in nonblank)
+        current_baseline = (proc.returncode, parsed, unparsed, proc.returncode != 0 and parsed == 0)
+        if current_baseline != baseline_expected.get(script):
+            baseline_mismatch.append((script, baseline_expected.get(script), current_baseline))
+        cross_ids = CROSS_RE.findall(merged)
+        if len(cross_ids) != parsed:
+            cross_only.append((script, parsed, len(cross_ids), len(cross_ids) - parsed))
+        blanks = len(all_lines) - len(nonblank)
+        if blanks:
+            blank_observations.append((script, blanks))
+        bad_schema = [r.get("schema") for r in rows if r.get("schema") != "findings/0"]
+        if bad_schema:
+            schema_bad.append((script, bad_schema))
+        current_count = summary(proc.returncode, rows)
+        if current_count != count_expected.get(script):
+            count_mismatch.append((script, count_expected.get(script), current_count))
+        vio_ids = [
+            (r["rule"] or r["sentinel"] or r["contract_ref"] or "", r["file"], r["symbol"] or "")
+            for r in rows if r["severity"] == "violation"
+        ]
+        duplicate_count = len(vio_ids) - len(set(vio_ids))
+        if duplicate_count:
+            duplicate_ids.append((script, duplicate_count))
+        total_records += len(rows)
+        proc_green, rows_green, _ = run_one(script, auto, fixture_name, False)
+        if proc_green.returncode != 0 or rows_green:
+            green_bad.append((script, proc_green.returncode, len(rows_green)))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "scripts": len(CASES),
+        "records": total_records,
+        "baseline_mismatch": baseline_mismatch,
+        "count_mismatch": count_mismatch,
+        "schema_bad": schema_bad,
+        "green_bad": green_bad,
+        "blank_lines_from_join_or_checker": blank_observations,
+        "cross_regex_minus_registry_regex": cross_only,
+        "duplicate_violation_id_tuples": duplicate_ids,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0 if not (baseline_mismatch or count_mismatch or schema_bad or green_bad) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env.update(extra_env or {})
+    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(root / "workspace/tools" / harness), *args],
+                       cwd=root, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
+    lines = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    summary = lines[-1] if lines else (p.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if p.stderr else "")
+    sample = next((line for line in lines if '"check-mechanism-ownership.py"' in line), "")
+    return p.returncode, summary, sample
+

+    found=set()

+            line=m.group(1).replace(str(fx)+"/","").replace(str(fx),"")

+    violations=sum(r["severity"]=="violation" for r in rows)

+        diff.append((script,violations,gate_entries,violations-gate_entries))
+print("checker, violation_records, registry_gate_entries, lost_or_collapsed")
